_notes:
Analog Devices ADXL345 3-axis accelerometer at 0x53 (ALT ADDRESS low, the Adafruit default) or 0x1D. 8-bit registers
Detection: DEVID (0x00) = 0xE5 (the ADXL313 at the same addresses reads 0xAD)
Init: DATA_FORMAT (0x31) = 0x09 - full resolution, +/-4 g; POWER_CTL (0x2D) = 0x08 - measure. BW_RATE is left at its reset value, 100 Hz
Poll (100 ms): DATAX0-DATAZ1 (0x32-0x37), little-endian 16-bit; at full resolution 3.9 mg per count whatever the range, so 256 per g
Source: registers from the Analog Devices ADXL345 datasheet

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-11-08, measuring): the lone 0x99 write and 1-byte read returns 0x00; registers 0x00-0x39 other than the data unchanged (reserved 0x17 moves between 0x17 and 0x18 without the probe too) and measuring carried on
